unit.why: A single narrative about the Besht granting R. Shmerel a son at the cost of his wealth, with a closing note on the son's later career.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מהרב ר' פאלק הכהן שחמיו
stories.end_quote: הי' בעת ההי' מ"ץ דק"ק סאגראן
stories.summary_en: The childless R. Shmerel, who hosts the Besht, is too ashamed to ask for a son; the Besht guesses his wish and threatens his wife with his staff so that she bears a son, R. David, but later explains that Heaven offered a choice between money or a son, so Shmerel loses all his wealth.
